sloka: रामो ऽयमिति विज्ञाय जहास विकृतस्वनम्।अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धो हरीन् विद्रावयन् रणे ।। ६.६७.१३३ ।।
transliteration: rāmo 'yamiti vijñāya jahāsa vikṛtasvanam।abhyadhāvata saṅkruddho harīn vidrāvayan raṇe ।। 6.67.133 ।।

translations.english: Having heard the words of the wise Prince, the monkeys collected climbed on Kumbhakarna happily.
